name: Umami
pitch: A simple, fast, privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.
description_md: Umami provides privacy-friendly website analytics with an approachable dashboard and no cross-site tracking. This recipe deploys the pinned upstream release as a Next.js standalone service backed by managed PostgreSQL and a controlled migration artifact.

blocked_reasons: The controlled-migrations and Next.js standalone capabilities are not production-ready.
The pinned recipe has not completed the recorded end-to-end deployment pass.
